scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,realtime -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:realtime"
scripts.dev:full: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n web,realtime,ml -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:realtime" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
